projects.title: Notification Agent
projects.description: An AI agent service built with FastAPI and LangGraph that autonomously generates context-aware notification suggestions by reasoning over real-time news and campaign data via a local Ollama LLM, with async/sync APIs and PostgreSQL persistence

projects.title: Bubble pop
projects.description: A computer vision based game where you are inside the game and pop virtual bubbles dropping on your screen using your hands to earn points.

projects.title: Identity Service
projects.description: A spring boot based service to generate unique ids at scale. The service is horizontally scalable and guarantees uniqueness of IDs.
